observations: Standing gas cooker with three gas burners and one electric hotplate.
Glass top lid is present and appears intact.
Front control panel has five knobs and one push button.
Oven door has a horizontal handle and a glass viewing pane.
The unit is partially wrapped in protective plastic film at the base.
Photo is taken outdoors; a car is visible in the background.
Watermark 'HITECH TECHNOLOGIES' is present on the image.
Camera footer indicates 'REDMI 12 | HITECH NI... LTD' and a date of 04/25/2025.

claims.evidence: Refurbishment quality cannot be assessed from a single external photo.
Requires video proof of all burners and the oven ignited.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: The seller also claims it is 'refurbished', which implies significant prior use or repair; the plastic wrapping suggests a commercial refurbisher.
Standard gas cookers do not have a 'motor' unless referring to a rotisserie or fan, which cannot be seen.
These documents are not shown in the photos.

risks.proof: Video showing the hotplate glowing or boiling water.

risks.risk: Oven burner or thermostat may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video of the oven interior with the burner lit.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a non-functional oven.

risks.risk: Internal rust or grease buildup behind the 'refurbished' exterior.
risks.proof: Photos of the oven interior and the rear of the appliance.

proof_requests: Video showing all three gas burners and the electric hotplate working simultaneously.
Video showing the oven burner lit and the interior condition.
Photo of the manufacturer's plate (usually on the back) to identify the brand and model.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card mentioned.
response.reason: The item is clearly a 3+1 standing cooker. Although the seller's text is contradictory and uses terms likely copied from other ads ('motor'), the photo appears to be an authentic shot from a refurbisher. It can be priced as a generic used/refurbished standing cooker.
